internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate
internal.body:
At 11:59 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate of 50%. Initial diagnosis identified error injection as the primary cause. Secondary factors considered included elevated latency and moderate CPU utilization, but these were not the root cause.

The remediation involved disabling the cartFailure flag at 12:19 UTC after approval. Post-action verification showed error rates dropped to normal levels (0.002), confirming recovery.

Key timeline:
- 11:59:35 Alert received
- 12:19:16 Diagnosis confirmed error injection
- 12:19:20 Flag disabled after approval
- 12:19:20 Recovery verified

Severity: SEV1

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.
